summary: Created a 5-phase plan to salvage and retire the nine stale local-only branches. Phases 1-2 write the four (c) findings (quantifier-free/witness-falsity non-determinism history; cvc5 mbqi+enum-inst feasibility and the unresolved CallableFunction segfault) into bimodal/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and solver/README.md as branch-independent engineering docs; Phase 3 bundles all nine to /home/benjamin/branch-archive/ModelChecker/ and verifies each; Phase 4 deletes the nine local branches behind an explicit gate on Phases 1-3; Phase 5 records the verdict table and evidence. No code changes, no tests, no push, no merge, no checkout.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan: durable (c) findings into bimodal ARCHITECTURE.md and solver README.md, verified out-of-repo bundles for all nine branches, gated git branch -D of all nine, verdict-table summary. Waves: [1,2,3] -> [4] -> [5]. Per-phase success criteria are shell commands.

decisions_made: All nine branches are deleted; none is kept. Every one is (a) superseded or (c) with its finding written to durable docs, and all nine are bundled regardless of verdict so retirement is reversible.
Archive path fixed at /home/benjamin/branch-archive/ModelChecker/ - outside the repo working tree and outside /tmp so it survives reboot.
Bundles use full refs (git bundle create <file> refs/heads/<branch>), not master..branch ranges, so each bundle is self-contained with no prerequisites and verifies standalone.

Findings split across two files by subject: witness/non-determinism history to bimodal/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, cvc5 feasibility plus known segfault to solver/README.md. This makes Phases 1-3 file-disjoint and parallelizable.
Plan states plainly that no code is ported and therefore no test phases exist, rather than inventing them.
Phase 1/2 success criteria include greps that fail if any branch name or any 'task N' citation appears in files under code/.
dead_ends: Do not use diff --stat against merge-base master as a delta measure - the shared merge-base (fcf2b95, 2024-02-08) predates the repo restoration, so it measures a Code/ -> code/ rename and pre-restoration churn, not branch content. The research already established the pairwise-ancestor deltas; do not re-run the triage.
Do not check out master or any stale branch. All branch content is readable with git show <branch>:<path> and git ls-tree.
